_comment: Copy to company-intel.json. Proteus's durable company memory: employer facts its work-ups learned (layoffs, benefits, RTO reversals, culture). score_jobs.py matches each key against a job's COMPANY field (word boundaries, case-insensitive) and adds `adjust` (clamped to +/-20); a negative entry also raises a flag. Proteus never writes this file itself: it appends proposals to state/company-intel-pending.jsonl via tools/record_intel.py, and tools/promote_intel.py (Dream step 2e) merges them here (locally by default; `--via-pr` opens a PR, for private forks only). company-intel.json itself is gitignored owner data. An entry whose `source` mentions 'owner' (or that carries "by_owner": true) is the owner's decision — a promotion may strengthen it but never weaken it (move toward zero, flip sign, drop tags, or replace the note).

Example Corp.note: Two reductions in force in the last year; verify team stability before investing.

Acme.note: A reading rule rather than a tilt: confirm the role is not a contract-to-hire before drafting.
